propositions: A declared-none file impact must classify distinctly from legacy empty-impact tickets and keep certified plans valid after unrelated commits without recomputing path-level dependency hashes
The manifest signing contract must emit an exact authenticated `file-scope: none` declaration only for none scope, while paths and unscoped manifests remain byte-identical to pre-feature output

A none-scoped signed attestation must return valid with verdict certified through compute_validity when dependencies are empty and scope is authenticated none, while unscoped or legacy records fall back to stale-head whole-HEAD freshness
Material fingerprint staleness must trigger on scope flips (none↔paths), reason-only edits to no_file_impact_reason, or any unauthenticated none declaration in plaintext mirrors
Recovery via resign_plan_review must preserve none scope in its new authenticated manifest and treat older manifests with no file-scope line as unscoped
The 800-line attest.py cap must be maintained by implementation tightening while adding signing-boundary scope lookup and classify_file_scope helper re-exports
